verdict.rationale: Deel's docs explicitly state its MCP server provides 'OAuth, scoped access, and tool discovery out of the box' and supports an OAuth install/authorization flow for AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, custom agents), which directly addresses issuing scoped credentials for agent use. However, there is no detail on how granular the scopes are, no documentation of a least-privilege scope-selection UI/API, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of this claim. Missing for 10: granular scope/permission documentation, developer-facing scope configuration examples, and independent verification of least-privilege enforcement.
